page.title: Status walls
page.description: Big-screen pages that show at a glance which machines are ready, in use or under maintenance. Screens open them by link, without signing in.
page.loadFailed: Could not load the status walls

regenerate.title: New link for {{name}}?
regenerate.body: Screens that show the current link stop showing the wall and need the new link.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Screens that show this wall stop showing it. This cannot be undone.

form.name: Name
form.needSelection: Choose at least one group or resource.
form.unlistedGroups: Selected groups that are not in this list: {{count}}. They are hidden from you or no longer exist.

errors.resourceUnavailable: The selection contains a resource you cannot see. It is hidden from you or no longer exists. Clear the resource selection, choose the resources again, then save.
errors.groupUnavailable: The selection contains a group you cannot see. It is hidden from you or no longer exists. Remove it from the selection, then save.
errors.allNeedsWholeList: You can only show all resources if you can see the whole machine list. Switch off "Show all resources" and choose groups or resources.

link.title: Link of {{name}}
link.body: Open this link on the screen. Anyone with the link sees the wall without signing in; use "New link" to revoke it. Double-click the wall to switch to full screen.

display.offline: No connection to the server: the wall may be out of date

gone.title: This link is no longer valid
gone.body: Ask a manager for the current link of this status wall.
